blocks.x: IoT, Twin & Robotics for Industrial Equipment & Machinery — sensing, simulating, acting — the operations stack that turns physical assets into self-correcting systems applied to the industrial equipment & machinery operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Equipment makers pivot to outcome businesses: connected machines, service contracts and uptime guarantees replace box sales. The pivot is an engineering program — fleet connectivity, service intelligence and outcome pricing — built once, monetized for decades.

items: Machines in the field lack telemetry; service is reactive and parts planning blind.
Field service scheduling by phone and spreadsheet; first-time-fix suffers.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Smart Infrastructure, Buildings & Cities, Digital Twin Platform Engineering, Connected Products & Smart Devices from the IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Fleet connectivity/OTA, Service dispatch and parts, Outcome/uptime contracts) on BI & Analytics Platform and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU Machinery Regulation/CRA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Cameras into instruments — inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.
Fix it before it fails — RUL models wired into planning, spare parts and work orders.
Robots into workflows — AMRs, cobots and autonomous vehicles integrated with safety and orchestration.
provisioning, OTA, telemetry per machine (service becomes predictive)
